findings.title: Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1 allows denial of service through deeply nested JSON
findings.evidence: PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="12.0.1" - GHSA-5crp-9r3c-p9vr (CVE-2024-21907), fixed in 13.0.1
findings.impact: A crafted FX-rate or import payload can exhaust CPU and stack on the API host, making order import unavailable.
findings.remediation: dotnet add OrderService.Api/OrderService.Api.csproj package Newtonsoft.Json --version 13.0.3 (non-breaking for JsonConvert usage).
